content:
The **Overlook Cabin** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia.

The outer area of the Overlook Cabin contains a pool and a Cooking Station. Inside, the ground floor of the building contains a kitchen and pool room as well as Scorched or a Scorched Wanderer. The pool room leads to a basement, where an Armor Workbench is located, along with a steamer trunk and a Picklock 2 Safe.

There are two card readers in the corners of the basement. The necessarily paired keycards are located at the Kanawha Nuka-Cola Plant and Tanagra Town. Using both card readers briefly opens a hidden room containing a keypad requiring a player character-specific one-time code generated at Ingram Mansion. Entering the correct code opens another hidden room (outside, to the right, through the doorway) holding TNT dome key 7.

There are two methods of accessing the top floor - the staircase and a collapsed piece of flooring which leads up into the remnants of a living room. A Caps Stash can be found on a shelf by the collapsed section. The top floor has two bedrooms - a children's room that contains many toys including an intact Giddyup Buttercup, and a master bedroom with a Bed. There are also several balconies that can be accessed from this floor. Anya's holotape can be found on the balcony connected to the living room with the collapsed floor.

- Anya's holotape - On a table on the front second-floor balcony, accessed by the only ramp created by broken floor, through the red door on the right.
- Secret door sale! - Note, in the hidden basement room, on the floor near the below mentioned key.
- TNT dome key 7 - In a hidden basement room, opened using the card readers. It opens TNT dome 7 at Black Mountain Ordnance Works.
- Two potential Vault-Tec Bobbleheads:
 - Northwest of the parking lot, in front of a blue car, on the ledge of the rocky cliff.
 - On the northern side of the exterior, by the broken windows and the pool table.
- Two potential Magazines:
 - On the second floor, near the door which leads out to the balcony, behind the radiator.
 - In the basement, on a table near the Armor Workbench.
- Potential Armor Plan - On the left side of the cabinet to the left of the Armor Workbench in the basement.
- Potential Recipe - At the very end of the kitchen area.

The Overlook Cabin appears in *Fallout 76*.

The card readers in the basement were added with patch 1.1.0.8.

- Interior

- Secret room with the one-time code keypad
- Secret room containing dome key 7
- TNT dome key 7 and Secret door sale!
